newsitem.title: USA: H&R Block buying Option One Mortgage Corp.
newsitem.headline: H&R Block buying Option One Mortgage Corp.

text.p: H&R Block Inc., expanding its presence in the financial services industry, said Wednesday that its Block Financial Corp. unit agreed to buy Option One Mortgage Corp. from Fleet Financial Group for $190 million.
Block, the country's biggest tax preparation firm, said the cash transaction was expected to be completed by the end of June, subject to regulatory approval and certain other conditions.

Option One, based in Santa Ana, Calif., is a major originator of sub-prime mortgage loans, with more than $1 billion in originations last year. It mainly offers mortgage loans on one-to-four-family residences.

"H&R Block's strategic vision is to be the preferred tax and financial partner for our customers. With the addition of Option One, we've greatly accelerated our entry into the financial services market," President and Chief Executive Frank L. Salizzoni said in a statement.
He said that Option One, which has a network of more than 5,000 mortgage brokers in 46 states, would complement H&R Block's current wholesale and retail mortgage channels.
Option One offers adjustable-rate and fixed-rate mortgages primarily to borrowers who do not qualify for loans that conform to traditional banking guidelines.
